registers.title: fcsr Fields
rows: Dynamic rounding mode, used when an instruction's rm is dyn (111)

registers.title: Rounding Modes (rm, frm)
rows: Round to nearest, ties to even
Round to nearest, ties to max magnitude
Dynamic: the rounding mode in frm (rm only)

registers.title: The Stack (ilp32d calling convention)
rows: The stack grows towards lower addresses; sp points to the last word in use
sp stays a multiple of 16 at every call
A function that calls others saves ra in its frame
Optional base of the frame, saved by the callee like every s register
Arguments that do not fit there are passed on the stack, at sp on entry
No red zone: memory below sp may be overwritten at any time
